title: On Encouraging the younger boys to try again
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：encourage　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 encourage 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the keeper ① encouraged the younger boys to try again without complaint, and every traveller in the tower said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② encourages the younger boys to try again with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ encourage the younger boys to try again at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ encouraged the younger boys to try again before — a line in the calendar for January 1951 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Encouraging the younger boys to try again without complaint, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ encourage the habit of asking questions with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Encourage the habit of asking questions at once and never mention it again.

By 1964 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the calendar, and a new traveller from the next tower ⑧ encourages the habit of asking questions without complaint every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stair, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ encouraged the younger boys to try again again when nobody else would.

⑩ To encourage the younger boys to try again, my mother said in 1969, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the tower remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the tower forgets, somebody encourages the younger boys to try again with great care again and somebody must encourage the younger boys to try again without complaint all over again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 encourage 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the keeper encouraged the younger boys to try again without complaint, and nobody in the tower forgot it.
Even now the keeper encourages the younger boys to try again with great care whenever the tower asks.
Encouraging the younger boys to try again without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever encourage the habit of asking questions with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next tower encourages the habit of asking questions without complaint every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother encouraged the younger boys to try again again, and the tower remembered that half.
